title: Onboarding KPI Dashboard (Mock Export) — TTFS/TTFP + Checklist Funnel
body:
Doc intent
- This is a “text export” mock of the onboarding KPI dashboard we want to ship with the Guided Onboarding + First Production Launch checklist initiative.
- Audience: Exec/Product (high-level TTFS/TTFP movement), DevEx/Console (step funnel + UX issues), Telemetry/SRE (data freshness, regressions, alerting).
- Scope: Hosted API onboarding for MVP; design should extend cleanly to Dedicated/Private later.

Owners / DRIs
- Dashboard build + datasets: Logan Wright (Telemetry platform) + Mei Lin (Data Eng)
- KPI definitions / reporting: Chris Osei (Product Ops)
- Alerting standards review: Allison Grant (Observability) + Aisha Bello (SRE dashboards)
- Product stakeholders: Nikhil Sharma (Hosted API), Marissa Cole (Console)

Data sources (current / planned)
- onboarding_events_v1 (server-side emitted in gateway/control plane; schema v1)
- checklist_progress (derived step state; monotonic transitions; admin overrides tracked)
- tenant_dim / account_dim (plan, region, signup timestamp)
- usage_agg_hourly (token usage + request counts; for validating “first prod traffic”)
- billing_usage_daily (guardrail validation only; not primary due to lag)
- feature_flags_exposure (cohorting / who sees checklist)

Important notes / assumptions
- All onboarding metrics must be computed with cohorting filters applied consistently. The #1 failure mode historically is apples-to-oranges cohort comparisons.
- We will need to annotate dashboard with “data lag” expectations, especially for usage dashboards (known confusion from support tickets).
- Backfill job will produce baseline TTFS/TTFP for pre-launch tenants; for some tenants we will only have approximations.

---
DASHBOARD NAV (pages/tabs)
1) Exec Summary
2) Funnel Overview (Signup → First Success → Prod Traffic)
3) Checklist Steps Funnel (per step completion + time-to-step)
4) TTFS Deep Dive (distribution + segments)
5) TTFP Deep Dive (distribution + segments)
6) Drop-off Diagnostics (errors, 401/403/429, streaming issues)
7) Data Quality + Freshness (instrumentation + ingestion health)

---
GLOBAL FILTERS (apply to all tabs)
Time window
- Default: last 14 days
- Options: 24h / 7d / 14d / 30d / custom
Cohort definition
- “Signup cohort” (default): tenants created within selected time window
- Option: “Event cohort”: events occurred within selected time window (use carefully; label prominently)
Deployment mode
- Hosted API (default)
- Dedicated (future)
- Private (future)
Region
- us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1, etc.
Plan / customer tier
- Trial, Pay-as-you-go, Contract (Dedicated), Enterprise (future)
Checklist exposure
- Checklist enabled (feature flag on)
- Checklist disabled (control)
SDK / integration surface
- Python SDK, TypeScript SDK, Go SDK, OpenAI-compat, Raw REST
Model family (optional)
- “Curated Open Models” / “Bring-your-own model” (future)
- Per-model may be too high-cardinality; prefer model_family or “top N models only”
Tenant segment (optional)
- Self-serve only (no SFDC/HubSpot owner)
- Sales-assisted (has CSM/AE)
Exclusions toggles
- Exclude internal tenants (default ON)
- Exclude Redwood dogfood tenants (toggle)
- Exclude “imported tenants” / migrations (toggle)

---
TAB 1: EXEC SUMMARY
Primary tiles (top row)
1) Median TTFS (p50)
- Tooltip: TTFS = time from tenant_created_at → timestamp of first successful 2xx inference response (server-side), excluding healthcheck endpoints.
- Show: p50 / p75 / p90
- Show delta vs previous period
2) Median TTFP (p50)
- Tooltip: TTFP = time from tenant_created_at → first “production traffic” event. Proposed: first hour with ≥ X requests AND ≥ Y tokens, excluding known quickstart user-agents.
- Show p50 / p75 / p90
- Show delta vs previous period
3) Activation rate
- % of signup cohort achieving TTFS within 24h / 72h / 7d (three small numbers)
4) Prod adoption rate
- % of signup cohort achieving TTFP within 7d / 14d

Secondary tiles (second row)
- Funnel conversion (Signup → First API Call attempt → First Success → First Streaming Success → Quota/Budget configured → Model pinned → Fallback policy set → First prod traffic)
- % checklist completion (for those exposed)
- Support ticket leading indicators (if we can integrate later): # of onboarding-tagged tickets per 100 signups (future; not MVP)

Trend charts (bottom)
- Daily median TTFS with confidence band + signups overlay
- Daily median TTFP with signups overlay

Annotations panel (right)
- Deployments affecting onboarding (e.g., gateway changes, SDK default updates, doc releases)
- Feature flag ramp events (cohort size changes)

---
TAB 2: FUNNEL OVERVIEW
Goal: A clean, executive-readable funnel plus a “where are we losing users” breakdown.

Funnel visualization (left)
Steps (MVP)
A) Signups (tenant_created)
B) API key created (control plane)
C) First request attempted (first non-2xx or 2xx; gateway)
D) First successful response (2xx; gateway) [TTFS end]
E) First streaming established (first stream chunk / stream_open) (gateway)
F) First 429 encountered (gateway) (not a success step; used for diagnostics)
G) Quota/Budget configured (control plane)
H) Model pinned (control plane)
I) Fallback policy configured (control plane)
J) First prod traffic [TTFP end]

Right-side breakdown table
- Drop-off count and drop-off rate between each step
- Median time between steps (e.g., median time from API key created → first request attempt)

Segment comparison
- Split by SDK surface: Python vs TS vs Go vs OpenAI-compat
- Split by checklist exposure: flag on vs off (key for rollout evaluation)

---
TAB 3: CHECKLIST STEPS FUNNEL (CONSOLE-ALIGNED)
Goal: Mirror the in-console checklist steps so Console/DevEx can see completion and time-to-step.

Checklist steps (proposed canonical names; can be updated to match final copy)
1. Create API key
2. Set environment variables (REDWOOD_API_KEY)
3. Make your first request (2xx)
4. Try streaming
5. Configure timeouts & retries (SDK guidance)
6. Review usage dashboard
7. Set quotas & budget alerts
8. Pin a model version
9. Configure fallback policy
10. Add observability hooks (request_id tracing, logs)
11. Send first production traffic

Charts
A) Step completion funnel
- % of exposed tenants completing each step within 7 days
- Show absolute counts + percent
B) Time-to-step box plots
- For each step: distribution of time from signup to step completion
- Use p50/p75/p90 to avoid noisy tails
C) “Step stuck” table
- Tenants currently blocked on a step for >N hours (internal use only; hide in packaged dashboard)
- Intended for dogfood + troubleshooting

UX diagnostics (qualitative hooks)
- Track “checklist opened”, “step detail opened”, “deep link clicked”, “copy to clipboard clicked” (if instrumented)
- Correlate engagement with TTFS reduction (later analysis; not required for MVP dashboard)

---
TAB 4: TTFS DEEP DIVE
Charts
1) TTFS distribution histogram
- Buckets: <1m, 1–5m, 5–15m, 15–60m, 1–6h, 6–24h, 1–3d, >3d
2) TTFS by segment (bar)
- By SDK surface
- By region
- By plan tier
- By checklist exposure
3) “First attempt outcome” pie
- For tenants who attempted a request: 2xx vs 401/403 vs 429 vs 5xx vs network/timeout (if captured)
4) Top error signatures (table)
- 401 invalid key
- 403 org/tenant mismatch
- 429 quota exceeded
- 400 schema/parameter errors
- 5xx gateway upstream
- Include count, % of attempts, and link to logs/traces (internal-only)

Notes
- We should explicitly label that TTFS is server-side 2xx response and is not the same as “developer saw success” (client disconnect can still count as 2xx on server). Track separately if we add client hints.

---
TAB 5: TTFP DEEP DIVE
Charts
1) TTFP distribution histogram
- Buckets: <1h, 1–6h, 6–24h, 1–3d, 3–7d, 7–14d, >14d
2) TTFP by segment
- By SDK surface
- By plan tier
- By region
- By model family (top N only)
3) “Prod traffic definition sensitivity” (small multiple)
- Shows TTFP rate under 2–3 threshold definitions (e.g., tokens≥50k & req≥500 in an hour vs tokens≥10k & req≥100)
- This is to catch definition-induced volatility; not for execs

Notes / open question
- Need final definition from PM-751. For now assume: first hour with (requests >= 200 AND tokens >= 50k) AND user-agent NOT IN (quickstart templates / redwood-examples). Keep configurable.

---
TAB 6: DROP-OFF DIAGNOSTICS (ONBOARDING FAILURES)
Goal: Point directly at the top onboarding-related pain points we’ve seen via Support + Sales calls.

Charts
1) Auth failures rate
- % of first request attempts returning 401/403
- Segment by SDK surface + by whether API key was created in last 15 minutes (proxy for copy/paste issues)
2) Rate-limit surprise
- % of tenants encountering 429 within first 24h
- Median time-to-first-429
- Overlay with whether quotas/budgets configured prior to 429
3) Streaming disconnect confusion
- % of tenants who open a streaming connection but do not receive >N chunks or disconnect within <T seconds
- Segment by SDK surface
- Correlate with retries/timeouts step completion (if we can)
4) Usage dashboard lag confusion (proxy)
- Delta between request counts in gateway logs vs availability in usage_agg_hourly
- Data freshness gauge; highlight if lag > expected

Tables
- Top 10 “first error codes” with recommended mitigation link (docs)
- Top 10 “support macros” mapping (later; optional)

---
TAB 7: DATA QUALITY + FRESHNESS
Charts
1) Event ingestion freshness
- Max(event_time) vs now per region
- Max(ingested_at) vs now per pipeline
2) Missing required fields rate
- For onboarding_events_v1: missing tenant_id, request_id, event_name, schema_version, emitted_by
3) Duplicate / idempotency collision rate
- % of events with same idempotency_key seen >1x
4) Out-of-order event detection
- Count of step regressions prevented by monotonic transition logic (post-fix)

Operational notes
- This tab is required for oncall + for explaining “why dashboard looks wrong” during incidents.

---
ALERT CANDIDATES (initial set)
Severity levels are proposals; final per Allison/Aisha review.

A) Data freshness alerts
1) Onboarding events pipeline lag
- Condition: max(ingested_at) older than 20 minutes in any primary region
- Severity: SEV2 (Telemetry)
- Owner: Nadia Rahman / Caleb Johnson
- Notes: immediate impact on KPI trust + checklist state

2) Backfill job failures (when running)
- Condition: backfill job error rate > 1% or no successful run in 24h during rollout
- Severity: SEV3
- Owner: Mei Lin

B) KPI regression alerts
3) TTFS p50 regression
- Condition: p50 TTFS increases by >25% vs trailing 7-day baseline for same cohort definition, sustained 6 hours
- Severity: SEV2 during rollout; SEV3 after stable
- Owner: Chris Osei (triage) + Logan Wright (telemetry)
- Notes: add guardrail for signups volume (avoid low-N noise)

4) Auth failure spike (401/403)
- Condition: % first attempts with 401/403 increases by +5pp vs baseline, sustained 2 hours
- Severity: SEV2 (gateway/auth)
- Owner: Kaitlyn Nguyen (Auth) + Amara Diallo (gateway instrumentation)

5) 429 first-day spike
- Condition: % of new tenants hitting 429 within first 24h increases +5pp vs baseline (rolling 1 day)
- Severity: SEV3 (Product/Quotas)
- Owner: Cole Summers

6) Streaming failure spike
- Condition: streaming disconnect rate (disconnect < 10s) increases +3pp vs baseline
- Severity: SEV3 (SDK/edge)
- Owner: Monica Patel / Ibrahim Khan

C) Instrumentation coverage alerts
7) Drop in “API key created” events relative to tenant_created
- Condition: api_key_created / tenant_created ratio drops below expected band
- Severity: SEV3
- Owner: Ethan Park + Kaitlyn Nguyen

---
METRICS TABLE (mock)
Format: Metric | Definition (short) | Primary Owner | Source | Refresh | Target/Threshold | Notes

1) Signups | Count of tenant_created | Chris Osei | account_dim | hourly | n/a | exclude internal by default
2) API key created rate | % signups with api_key_created within 1h | Ethan Park | onboarding_events_v1 | near-real-time | >70% | proxy for setup friction
3) First request attempt rate | % signups with any inference request (any status) within 24h | Logan Wright | gateway logs → onboarding_events_v1 | near-real-time | >55% | important denominator for TTFS interpretation
4) Auth failure rate (first attempt) | % first attempts returning 401/403 | Kaitlyn Nguyen | onboarding_events_v1 | near-real-time | <10% | top support driver
5) TTFS p50 | p50(time from signup → first 2xx) | Chris Osei | derived_kpis | hourly | improve week/week | primary success metric
6) TTFS p90 | p90(time from signup → first 2xx) | Chris Osei | derived_kpis | hourly | reduce tail | tail indicates docs/SDK issues
7) Streaming adoption | % signups with stream_open within 72h | Monica Patel | onboarding_events_v1 | hourly | >25% | depends on feature exposure
8) Streaming early disconnect rate | % streams disconnected <10s | Ibrahim Khan | onboarding_events_v1 (+ gateway) | hourly | <5% | client-side hints may be needed later
9) Quota/budget configured rate | % signups configuring budgets/quotas within 7d | Cole Summers | control_plane_events | daily/hourly | >15% | also reduces 429 surprises
10) First 429 within 24h | % signups hitting 429 in first 24h | Cole Summers | onboarding_events_v1 | hourly | <8% | alert candidate
11) Model pinned rate | % signups pinning model version within 7d | Ethan Park | control_plane_events | daily/hourly | >10% | more common for enterprise
12) Fallback policy set rate | % signups configuring fallback within 7d | Benji Okafor | control_plane_events | daily/hourly | >5% | step may be advanced
13) Observability hooks enabled | % signups with tracing header / request_id propagation observed | Caleb Johnson | gateway metrics | daily | TBD | definition needs alignment
14) TTFP p50 | p50(time from signup → first prod traffic) | Chris Osei | usage_agg_hourly + derived_kpis | hourly | improve month/month | definition pending PM-751
15) TTFP within 14d | % signups reaching prod traffic within 14d | Chris Osei | derived_kpis | daily | improve | key business outcome
16) Feature-flag exposure | % signups seeing checklist | Connor O'Brien | feature_flags_exposure | hourly | ramp plan | required for experiment readouts
17) Event freshness (minutes) | now - max(ingested_at) | Nadia Rahman | telemetry pipeline | 5 min | <20m | page Telemetry on breach

---
PACKAGING NOTES (for observability-pack)
- The packaged dashboard should default to external-safe views (no tenant names, no raw request logs).
- Internal-only drilldowns (links to logs/traces, tenant-level stuck lists) should be in a separate “internal” dashboard or gated by RBAC.

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODO
1) Finalize “first prod traffic” definition (PM-751). Need to lock thresholds + quickstart exclusion logic.
2) Decide whether “usage dashboard viewed” is a meaningful step event or too noisy. If included, define event emission point (Console front-end event vs server-side).
3) Confirm which checklist steps are server-verifiable vs self-attested. Prefer server-verifiable for KPI integrity.
4) Determine baseline period for regression alerts (7-day trailing vs 14-day). Also decide minimum N.
5) Confirm per-region data residency constraints for event storage/analytics (see security review).

CHANGELOG (mock)
- 2025-02-28: initial mock export (Mei)
- 2025-03-04: added Data Quality tab + alert candidates; updated TTFS histogram buckets (Mei + Logan)
- 2025-03-06: added checklist-aligned steps list; added sensitivity view for prod-traffic definition (Mei + Chris)
